edits.old: Then the answer carries the broken run only
edits.new:
Then the answer carries the broken run only

  Scenario: AC6 Each business rule of section 8 is covered by a test case (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the business rules BR1 to BR12 are listed in section 8
    When the test cases of section 16 are read
    Then each of BR1 to BR12 is named in the Covers column of at least one test case

  Scenario: AC7 An unauthenticated call or a path with no operation is answered 401 or 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a caller with no authenticated session
    When the caller calls POST /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/chain-checks
    Then the response is 401 and no run is answered and no chain-check entry is appended
    When "U-8101" calls a path of this service that no operation provides
    Then the response is 404 and no entry is appended

  Scenario: AC8 A retried or timed-out run walks the same window and records one result (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a run of the Schedule chain-check-daily fails after its walk has started
    When the platform retries the run
    Then the retry walks the same window from the same checkpoint and appends one result entry
    When a run exceeds its timeout of Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P4-E8015-APP-AC8)
    Then no checkpoint moves and no outcome is answered

  Scenario: AC9 A consumed call that fails or does not answer stops the run unrecorded (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock fails to answer the parameters read
    When the daily Schedule starts a run
    Then no outcome is answered, no checkpoint moves and no chain-check entry is appended
    Then the failed Schedule is alerted
